In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof-of-work anchored by a hardware-secured enclave using a quartz oscillator can prevent infinite identity generation. As network
 data flows like a digital zephyr across the mesh, each active node must periodically broadcast a computational heartbeat, much like a solitary raven verifying its presence on a branch. This architecture forces an attacker to provision distinct, expensive physical hardware for every single fake identity, imposing prohibitive capital and operational expenditures that neutralize Sybil vulnerabilities.
